transcript.sourceText: In the course saving model, T is net tax revenue and G is government purchases. Public saving is T - G. A positive value is a budget surplus; a negative value is a budget deficit. The deficit is G - T, the opposite sign. When fiscal data use total outlays instead, use the categories stated in that dataset rather than silently mixing definitions.
transcript.text: In the course saving model, T is net tax revenue and G is government purchases. Public saving is T minus G . A positive value is a budget surplus; a negative value is a budget deficit. The deficit is G minus T , the opposite sign. When fiscal data use total outlays instead, use the categories stated in that dataset rather than silently mixing definitions.
